title: Fairness-Aware and Latency-Controllable Scheduling for Chunked-Prefill LLM Serving
authors: Haoxin Liu; Jiayi Wang; Yueshen Xu; Rui Li
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: In chunked-prefill LLM serving, the default FCFS policy degrades fairness under mixed workloads — short requests suffer chunk-level head-of-line blocking while long requests risk starvation — and static token budgets ignore that identical token counts can incur very different execution times, causing unpredictable latency jitter and low GPU utilization.
problem_statement.zh: 在 chunked-prefill 的 LLM serving 中，預設的 FCFS 排程在混合工作負載下造成公平性劣化：短請求受 chunk 層級的 head-of-line blocking 影響，長請求則面臨飢餓風險；同時靜態 token budget 忽略相同 token 數可能對應差異極大的執行時間，導致延遲抖動不可預測且 GPU 利用率偏低。

key_innovation.en: Three lightweight scheduling mechanisms atop Sarathi-Serve: (1) an aging policy that ranks prefill candidates by P_i = α·(waiting time) + β·(remaining prefill tokens), maintained via a max-heap in O(k log n); (2) LPRS, which replaces the static token budget with an offline-trained MLP batch-latency predictor and a discrete chunk-size search that minimizes deviation from a target latency budget; (3) APC, a dynamic activity cap with minimum-effective-progress and warm-start rules that suppresses fragmented prefill chunks.
key_innovation.zh: 在 Sarathi-Serve 之上的三個輕量排程機制：(1) Aging 策略以 P_i = α·等待時間 + β·剩餘 prefill tokens 排序 prefill 候選請求，透過 max-heap 以 O(k log n) 維護；(2) LPRS 以離線訓練的 MLP batch 延遲預測器取代靜態 token budget，並以離散搜尋選擇 chunk 大小、最小化與目標延遲預算的偏差；(3) APC 以動態 activity cap、最小有效進度與 warm-start 規則抑制碎片化的 prefill chunk。

key_improvements.en: Aging reduces mean E2E latency by over 10% (10.24%) and mean TTFT by 11.27% vs FCFS at 256-token chunks; under high concurrency LPRS cuts P99 prefill latency from 924.22 ms to 889.45 ms; APC reduces mean request E2E latency by 22.26% and P90 by 24.62% while raising average prefill chunk size from 0.78 to 6.29.
key_improvements.zh: Aging 在 256-token chunk 下較 FCFS 降低平均 E2E 延遲逾 10%（10.24%）、平均 TTFT 降低 11.27%；高並發下 LPRS 將 P99 prefill 延遲由 924.22 ms 降至 889.45 ms；APC 使平均請求 E2E 延遲降低 22.26%、P90 降低 24.62%，並將平均 prefill chunk 大小由 0.78 提升至 6.29。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 4090, NVIDIA RTX 5090, NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000, Huawei Ascend 910B
gpu_count: 1x RTX 4090 / 2x RTX 5090 / 1x RTX PRO 5000 / 1x Ascend 910B (per experiment)
reported_accuracy: MAPE 1.26% (MAE 1.13 ms, RMSE 1.53 ms; 99% of predictions within 5 ms)
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Synthetic (49:1 short:long prompt mix for APC)

scope_assumptions.en: The latency predictor is trained offline per deployment from 36,868 profiled scheduling rounds on the same hardware; LPRS/APC experiments fix TP=PP=1 on a single GPU; validation is limited to 8B-scale models, sequences up to 4,096 tokens, and single-node scale — the authors defer larger models, longer contexts, multi-node deployment, and multi-tenant settings to future work.
scope_assumptions.zh: 延遲預測器需針對部署環境離線訓練（在相同硬體上蒐集 36,868 筆排程回合樣本）；LPRS/APC 實驗固定 TP=PP=1、僅使用單一 GPU；驗證僅涵蓋 8B 規模模型、最長 4,096 tokens 的序列與單節點規模——作者將更大模型、更長 context、多節點部署與多租戶情境列為未來工作。
